content.short: walllet.com is a non-custodial, passkey-powered smart wallet with no seed phrase to lose and gas payments via ERC-20 tokens.
content.description: Traditional wallets rely on seed phrases, confusing interfaces, and holding native tokens just to cover gas fees. walllet.com replaces these barriers with non-custodial passkeys, so there's no seed phrase to lose. Gas can be paid using ERC-20 tokens such as USDT or USDC, and the streamlined, intuitive UI guides you through every step with clarity. The app supports multiple networks, including Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Avalanche, OP Mainnet, Polygon, Aptos, Bitcoin, and Solana, making crypto more approachable for everyone.
content.meta: walllet.com is a non-custodial, passkey-powered smart wallet with a user-friendly UI. Discover walllet.com and other Web3 Wallets on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
